versions.subject: feat: add rules related to rogue rdp
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        # Covers potential downloads/clicks from browsers
        - '\brave.exe'
        - '\CCleanerBrowser.exe'
        - '\chrome.exe'
        - '\chromium.exe'
        - '\firefox.exe'
        - '\iexplore.exe'
        - '\microsoftedge.exe'
        - '\msedge.exe'
        - '\opera.exe'
        - '\vivaldi.exe'
        - '\whale.exe'
        # Covers potential downloads/clicks from email clients
        - '\outlook.exe'
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\mstsc.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'mstsc.exe'
condition: all of selection_*
